title: VenTu — Open-source water-sports conditions for Portugal
description: Open-source surf and water-sports conditions for Portugal: 185 spots, live cams, per-sport scores, hourly forecasts, interactive map, Dawn Patrol and automated AI news. Aggregates Open-Meteo marine/wind models, IPMA and Instituto Hidrográfico observations (waves, buoys, warnings, radar) and MeteoAlarm alerts. Please also cite Open-Meteo (Zippenfenig, 2023, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7970649) for the forecast data.
